info.name: Black Tiger Commerce API
info.description:
All Commerce API endpoints (M1 mock + M2 content).

**Local stack:**
- Commerce API: http://localhost:3001
- Swagger: http://localhost:3001/docs
- Odoo: http://localhost:8069

**Demo user:** demo@blacktiger.com.sa / Password1!

Import `Black-Tiger-Local.postman_environment.json` and run **Auth → Login (demo user)** first for protected routes.

request.description: Seeded demo user. Saves accessToken + refreshToken to environment.
